private_by_team.SPIKLENCI: V přijaté scénářové minulosti ses podílel na přípravě jednoho otisku rituálu. Znáš své spolupracovníky a vlastní motiv. Vypravěč tvou příslušnost nikomu nevydá.
private_by_team.STRAZCI: Přišel jsi s legitimním scénářovým důvodem. Máš vlastní zaznamenanou výchozí scénu, jednu stopu a jednu výpověď. Neznáš cizí týmy.

starting_personal_log_minimum: one owned or received starting evidence record

evidence_graph_template.chain_target_assignment: independently seeded permutation of the actual conspirator IDs; public chain number never encodes seat order
materialization_algorithm: For each true target choose a distinct foil from other players with a purpose-separated seeded order.
For N<=12 choose distinct decoy_a and decoy_b, both different from target and foil. A=[target,foil,decoy_a]; B=[target,foil,decoy_b]; C=[target,decoy_a,decoy_b].
For N>=13 choose eight distinct decoys apart from target and foil. A=[target,foil,a1,a2,a3]; B=[target,foil,b1,b2,b3]; C=[target,a1,b1,c1,c2].

Materialize the structured candidate_recipes above. Shuffle displayed candidate order with a separate seed. Every pair AB, AC and BC must retain at least two candidates; A intersect B intersect C must equal target.
Other conspirators may be decoys; no quota of traitors per candidate group is advertised.
Each fact receives a world-event provenance link stored server-side. User-facing source labels do not encode actor IDs.
invariants: target belongs to all three candidate sets
each candidate set contains at least three players
every pairwise intersection AB, AC and BC has at least two players
intersection of A B C is exactly target
all noncanonical prelude acts accepted before start
evidence_graph_template.new_alignment_facts_per_chapter: at most T different facts; duplicated delivery of same fact is not new logical information
evidence_graph_template.selection_among_simultaneous_valid_reque: stable seeded ordering over locked actor/order IDs; timestamp does not confer priority
evidence_graph_template.duplicate_inspections: May confirm or copy the same already available fact; never generate unlimited new exclusion tests.
evidence_graph_template.additional_evidence: Actual movements, held objects, attacks, sabotage and explicitly shared statements generate event-backed facts subject to visibility.

allowed_effects: redirect one delivery to another eligible recipient
delay one delivery for one chapter

chapters.title: Dům má připomínky
chapters.public_scheduled_message: Dům uznal přítomné za hosty. O jejich vhodnosti si ponechal výhrady. Ochranná pečeť je narušená. Do posledního zvonu zbývá šest kapitol. Správce zdůrazňuje, že záloha se při konci světa nevrací.
chapters.learning_goal: Výchozí scéna a první potvrzená akce.
